description: This source file defines a C# class 'Css' that provides methods to interact with JavaScript functions via JSInterop in a Blazor project. It encapsulates calls to show and hide body overflow by invoking external JavaScript functions.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class that provides methods to manipulate CSS properties via JavaScript interop in a Blazor application.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to show the body overflow, with no return value.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to hide the body overflow, returning a string result.
